title: Cisco Meraki operations
description: Know when a Meraki site is in trouble before users call: devices going offline, Auto VPN tunnels dropping, WAN uplinks losing packets or adding latency, Dashboard health alerts piling up, and licences about to expire. Everything comes from the Meraki Dashboard API through the Cisco Meraki add-on.

requiredData.notes: Install the Cisco Meraki Add-on for Splunk on a heavy forwarder or the search head, add an organisation with a read-only Dashboard API key, and enable the device availability, appliance SD-WAN, uplink loss and latency, assurance alert, and licence inputs.

industrySources.control: Dashboard network alerts: device offline, VPN connectivity change, uplink status change, licence expiry
Device reporting via API: availability, uplink loss/latency and alert data for external monitoring
Cisco Meraki add-on API inputs and sourcetypes

curationNotes: Skips UCs that read the plain 'meraki' syslog sourcetype (SC4S or direct syslog), because the default add-on collects from the Dashboard API.
Five steps on purpose: these map one-to-one to the Dashboard alert categories most sites enable first.
All five sidecars have no verification status yet; verify before publishing.
